title: Select adversarial actor branch and review panel
reason: Use coordinator-owned mechanism state to rank candidate actor branches and choose the review/unification path. Agent ballots are recommendations until the coordinator or a human applies the selection.

proposals.label: minimal-actor
proposals.description: Prefer the smallest validated actor patch and send it through the standard critic and tester panel.

proposals.label: traceable-actor
proposals.description: Prefer the actor branch with the clearest evidence, checkpoint refs, and contract-level audit trail.

proposals.label: research-first
proposals.description: Pause branch selection long enough to run a sourced research task, then let the unifier apply the information-use plan to the candidate comparison.
